properties.name: FarmFall
properties.description:
FarmFall is a fast-paced drop-and-match puzzle game filled with adorable farm animals. Your goal is simple:
Drop animals from above, match identical ones, and score as high as you can!

With easy tap-to-play controls, colorful visuals, and an addictively satisfying gameplay loop, FarmFall is suitable for players of all ages. Challenge your reflexes, improve your timing, and try to beat both your daily best score and your all-time high score!

⭐ Features

Simple one-tap gameplay: Just tap to drop the animal!

Match & merge mechanics: Combine identical animals to earn points.

Daily best score tracking: Can you beat today’s top score?

All-time high score system: Your record is always saved—keep pushing your limits!

Cute, colorful graphics: A cheerful farm theme with lovable characters.

Offline play: Enjoy anytime, anywhere—no internet required.

Quick & addictive sessions: Perfect for breaks, commutes, and casual play.

🎯 Your goal is clear:

Drop, match, and break your record!

Test your timing and strategy in this charming puzzle adventure.
How high can your score get in FarmFall?

eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: PanelSpriteButton
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: A button that can be customized.
description: A button that can be used for menus and most labelled buttons of a game. The button can be customized with a background for each state and a label. It handles user interactions and a simple condition can be used to check if it is clicked.
There are ready-to-use buttons in the asset-store [menu buttons pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=menu-buttons-menu-buttons).

changelog.breaking: - Buttons now use "variants", allowing easy swapping of their visual aspect. You will have to make some adjustments to existing buttons in your project. Follow this [migration documentation](https://wiki.gdevelop.io/gdevelop5/objects/custom-objects-prefab-template/migrate-to-variants/) to do these changes.
